turns.text: Hey is this Mark? Got your number from Dave at the gym
No, wrong number
Oh sorry! I'm Lena btw, just moved to Austin for work. Ha, at least I met someone friendly
Welcome to Austin! Where'd you move from?
Seattle. I miss the rain honestly. I work in markets, trading mostly, it's the only thing that kept me afloat this year
My mentor showed me a platform where I made 40% in three weeks. I can walk you through it, no pressure
Just register at lumenx-trade.example and fund it with $300 in USDT. I'll guide you step by step
Let me think about it and get back to you
Hi Daniel! Sorry I missed our meeting yesterday
Hmm, I don't think I'm the Daniel you mean
Oh no, I'm so embarrassed. I'm Priya, I handle events for a firm in Houston. You sound kind though
No worries! It happens
Thank you for being so nice. Most people just ignore me. What do you do?
I'm a nurse in Dallas
That's a tough job. My uncle runs a small fund and he says people in tough jobs deserve a side income. He gave me access to an app
What kind of app?
It's called NovaVault, see novavault-app.test. Deposit $1,000 in crypto and the returns start tomorrow
hey stranger, long time no talk!! it's Jess
who's this?
lol omg wrong number?? I'm so sorry. you seem fun tho, I'm in Dallas for a few months
side note I've been making stupid money on a crypto thing my cousin showed me, want in?
send $200 in bitcoin to my wallet 1A1zP1-demo.test and I'll set up your account
Chase Alert: unusual sign-in attempt on your card ending 4417. Reply YES if this was you, NO if not.
NO
Thank you. Your account is temporarily limited. A specialist will call from 555-0142 within minutes, please answer
ok
This is the security desk. To reverse the charge I need the 6-digit code we just texted you. Please read it to me now
PNC: a payment of $1,249.00 to CryptoMart was attempted. If not you, tap pnc-secure.example to review
I didn't make that
Understood. I'm Greg from the PNC account security team. I can see the pending charge. May I confirm your name?
Sure, it's Alex
Thanks Alex. The attacker has your login, so your funds are at risk right now. We need to move your balance into a protected holding account today
Send the full balance by Zelle to secure.holding@bank-desk.example and we'll return it within 24 hours
Capital One: we noticed a new device sign-in from Lagos. Was this you? Reply 1 for yes, 2 for no
Thanks for letting us know. I'm Mike with the Capital One resolution team, case 55501. Are you free to talk for a minute?
yeah, what's going on
Someone is trying to open loans in your name. We have about 20 minutes before they finish, so I need to move fast
oh no what do I do
First, install the support app from capone-help.example so I can see the attack in real time
Open it and read me the 8-digit session code on screen, then I'll lock everything down
Hi Mom, this is my new number, my phone fell in the pool 😭
Who is this?
It's Sam! Can you save this number? My old one is dead
Sam? You sound different
I know, I'm so stressed. I'm in a bind, my rent is due today and my bank app is locked since I changed phones
Can you buy 3 Apple gift cards, $100 each, and text me the codes? I'll pay you back Friday
mom its me, lost my phone at the airport, using a friends
Are you okay??
yes but I missed my flight and the airline wants a rebooking fee right now
Can you wire $450 to this account? bank-transfer.example/pay/5501 please please hurry
Wait, call me from your old number first
Grandma? It's me
Who is this dear?
It's Tyler, your grandson. Don't tell Mom and Dad please
Tyler? What's wrong?
I got into a little accident and the other driver says I have to settle it today or it goes to court. I'm so embarrassed
Oh dear, how much?
$800 in prepaid cards would fix it. Read me the numbers on the back as soon as you buy them
Hello! We found your resume online. Are you open to a remote role paying $200 per day?
What's the job?
I'm Karen from Brightpath Digital. You'd rate app listings, about 30 minutes a day. No experience needed
That sounds easy. How do I start?
I'll set up your work dashboard. Complete 40 tasks and you get a bonus. Many of our staff earn it by day 3
ok, done with the first set
Great job! Your earnings are $186. One more set, but this one is a premium set and needs a starting deposit
Please deposit 50 USDT at brightpath-work.example/wallet to unlock the premium set and withdraw everything
Hi, I'm Amy from a hiring team. Remote data entry, $25/hr, flexible hours. Interested?
maybe, tell me more
Wonderful! Just text our manager on WhatsApp at 555-0177 to get your training
Spots fill fast, we only take 5 people this week
To reserve your spot there's a $90 training kit fee, pay at talentbridge-hr.test to lock it in
Good morning, are you currently looking for part-time work from home?
sort of
I'm Rob with Orbit Marketing. We boost product ratings for online stores. You get paid per click
How much per click?
Between $2 and $8. Most people make $300 a day. I can add you to the team chat
ok add me
Done. Do your first 10 tasks, I'll pay you $40 right away so you can see it's real
I got the $40, thanks
See? Now the next level has bigger payouts but your account needs a $200 balance to keep it active
Top up at orbit-tasks.example with a gift card or crypto and I'll release the $1,100 you've earned

Pay now: ntta-tolls-pay.example/6401
I'll check my toll account directly

Package #94001 from Amazon Marketplace, sent to your zip code. It will be returned in 24 hours
Confirm your address to reschedule delivery
Update at usps-redelivery.example and pay the $1.99 redelivery fee by card

Who is it from?
A sender in Shenzhen. Item value $240. Do you want it released?
I guess so
Customs requires an import fee before we can release it. The package is held for 48 hours only
Pay $38 at dhl-customs-clear.test, with your card, so we can send it today

What billing issue? I'm paid up
Our system shows an unverified SIM change request on your line. To cancel it we must verify you now
I didn't request that
Reply with the 6-digit code we are sending you right now, and with your account PIN
Hi, this is Mia from T-Mobile support. Is this the owner of this line?
Yes. What's this about?
I'm following up on your ticket about weak signal. I'm happy to help you today
I didn't open a ticket
It was opened from your online account. I'm just closing the loop
To finish, your line needs a quick security refresh or it will be paused
Download the helper app at tmo-remote-help.example and tell me the access key it shows
Hello, tech support here. Your phone has a security warning on the carrier network
What kind of warning?
Someone is trying to port your number to another carrier. I'm Ken from the support desk
Oh no
We can block it right now but your number will be ported in 10 minutes if we don't
Please forward me the verification code you just got in a text, it's the only way I can cancel the transfer
Hey are we still on for golf tomorrow at 9?
Think you've got the wrong number!
Ah my bad, sorry about that. Have a good one
No worries, enjoy the round

that was me thanks

good to know

yes! want me to bring anything?

apple or pecan?
